title: Tree BFS (level order)
learn: queue-based level traversal, level size loop, right view / zigzag / min depth
hook: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal and Right Side View are extremely common, and BFS is also how you find the nearest leaf quickly. The level-size loop you learn here returns in graphs as multi-source BFS.

explain.prompt: Explain level order traversal: how the queue is used and how you know where one level ends.
keyPoints: start with the root in a queue; repeatedly pop from the front and push children at the back
at the start of each round, len(queue) is the number of nodes on the current level
process exactly that many nodes to collect one level
O(n) time, O(w) space for the queue (w = widest level); use collections.deque
